description: This file defines API routes for managing bookings in a travel planning backend, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting bookings, with access control based on logged-in user and ownership of trips.

methods.name: None _assert_trip_owned(db: AsyncSession, trip_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Checks if the trip belongs to the current user. Raises 404 HTTPException if not.

methods.name: list[BookingOut] list_bookings( trip_id: int | None = None, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Lists bookings for the current user, optionally filtered by trip_id.

methods.name: BookingOut create_booking( payload: BookingCreate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Creates a new booking after verifying trip ownership and date constraints.

methods.name: BookingOut get_booking( booking_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves a booking if it belongs to the current user's trip.

methods.name: BookingOut update_booking( booking_id: int, payload: BookingUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Updates an existing booking, verifying ownership and date consistency.

methods.name: DeleteResponse delete_booking( booking_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Deletes a booking if it belongs to the current user.
